Subject: Q3 Executive HC authorization + comp-band clarifications

Team — attaching the consolidated Q3 executive HC ask (spreadsheet + comp-band guidance). Two asks that need quick alignment so recruiting can proceed this week:

1) Authorization to open and extend offers for: Director of Product (Platform) x1, Head of ML Infra (Sr Director level) x1.
2) Final comp-band for the Head of ML Infra search — hiring panel is recommending SR.D band given the infra breadth; finance wants explicit confirmation of band and approval for target vs. stretch.

Attachments: Q3-HC-ask.xlsx, comp-band-guidance.pdf, offer-template-exec.docx

Quick context: these roles are escalation hires tied to product roadmap milestones (model serving performance and platform stability). We forecast interviews and offers to conclude by end of Aug if we get approvals today/tomorrow.

Ask: Laura/Vivek — can I get headcount authorization + preferred band guidance by EOD tomorrow? Recruiting is lined up with TalentBridge (cc).

Thanks,
Hannah
--
Hannah Schmitt
VP, Talent & People Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Q3 Executive HC authorization + comp-band clarifications

Hannah — thanks for the summary and attachments. A few quick notes from finance:

- Total committed run-rate impact (base + OTE for hires) is shown in tab "RunwayImpact" in the spreadsheet. At target comp the net burn increase is ~$820k/year.
- We are comfortable with both hires provided we: (a) keep at most one hire at stretch compensation, and (b) agree to deferral clauses (90-day performance review to trigger full equity vesting schedule).
- For the Head of ML Infra: prefer Sr.Director band only if the candidate clearly demonstrates prior org-level ownership (multi-team infra, 12+ engineers). Otherwise, approve Director band with an aggressive performance plan.

I can sign off conditionally today if Laura is aligned on the one-stretch rule.

Vivek
CFO

Vivek / Hannah — quick technical/competitive note: the market for top ML infra leaders is tight. If we present Director-level offers only, we risk losing candidates in the final loop. For the Head role, the difference in total comp between a Director offer and a Sr.Director offer can materially change acceptance odds. I recommend we hold the stretch slot for the Head of ML Infra, but couple it with a firm 90-day/6-month deliverable milestone plan.

Also flag: hiring a Director of Product (Platform) at target comp is fine — we can accelerate onboarding to reduce dependency on interim contractors.

— Markus
CTO

- If Vivek okays the one-stretch rule, HR will include the stretch slot in the offer authorization memo and require hiring manager sign-off for the stretch.
- We will include the 90-day performance checkpoint language and an opt-in accelerated equity vesting schedule tied to milestone completion.

Recruiting (TalentBridge) is prepared to present a shortlist by next Wednesday assuming we post the reqs today. Sarah (cc) can expedite candidate outreach.

Thanks everyone — I approve both headcount requests with the following conditions:

1) Head of ML Infra authorized at Sr.Director band (stretch slot) on the condition that we codify a 90-day performance review and measurable milestones. If the candidate does not meet milestones, compensation reverts to Director-level OTE and equity acceleration is paused.
2) Director of Product (Platform) approved at target Director band.
3) One-stretch rule acknowledged — we'll keep only the Head role as stretch.
4) Marissa/Hannah to submit final offer letters + compensation memo to Finance for recording prior to sending offers.

Please proceed — recruiting may post the reqs and TalentBridge can begin outreach. Final sign-offs by email are fine; we will capture approvals in the HR record.

Laura
CEO
